propositions: transition lib signature must match claim's canonical shape: force: str | None = None (audit reason), removing the force: bool and force_close params
The force-bypass audit reason must ride exclusively on --force[=<reason>], not on a separate --reason param, uniformly across claim and transition CLI and library

In-memory references to the force-bypass concept must be spelled force_reason consistently across transition and claim internals, while retaining the persisted status_data[force_close_reason] key unchanged
Legacy transition(force_close=...) and transition(force=True) calls must warn via deprecation alias and map to the new force string param to preserve caller safety
Bare --force must normalize to (no reason given) and --force=<reason> must pass that reason identically for both transition and claim verbs
